question: Within an already-confirmed OKX V1.7 12H reclaim, do three consecutive H1 closes on the inward side of the touched Monday 1.618 differ economically from a last-hour-only reclaim?
single_variable: Condition only the original 12H V1.7 event on completed H1 closes inside the exact touched-side Monday 1.618 within that signal key. All entries, fixed stops, four-child allocation, queue priority, actual price paths, leverage schedule, volume budget, fees and exits stay frozen.

novelty_audit.wick_timing: exp-cloud-close-wick-timing-20261109-v1 measures elapsed hours since the final H1 wick strictly crossed the extension, not consecutive H1 closes inside the extension.
novelty_audit.reclaim_failure: exp-cloud-close-reclaim-failure-20261109-v1 measures post-entry closes through the extension as an exit, not H1 acceptance within the signal key.
novelty_audit.second_reclaim: exp-cloud-close-second-reclaim-20261109-v1 measures a later separate 12H event in the same week.
novelty_audit.breakout_historical: exp-cloud-close-breakout-historical-20261109-v1 compares the original 12H reclaim event with an outside-band breakout event; it does not condition the reclaim on its internal H1 close sequence.

input_pool.control: The frozen no-gate all-observable balanced account is the comparison/control. This queue source is actual V1.7 signals only; it contains no separate non-signal matched controls.

decision_clock.original_signal: Completed native UTC 12H V1.7 key; entry_ms equals its confirmation close and exact next H1 open.
decision_clock.execution: The H1 open at entry_ms is used only as the next-open entry price and is excluded from close features. No H1 or 12H observation after entry_ms can determine eligibility.
decision_clock.week_gate: The 12H key must be wholly inside the same New York week after Monday 1H range completion; use the same America/New_York Monday window as native V1.7.

price_states.inside_strict: Long: H1 close > the frozen touched lower 1.618. Short: H1 close < the frozen touched upper 1.618. Equality is neither inside nor outside.
price_states.stable_3: All three final contiguous completed H1 closes are strictly inside.
price_states.last_only_1: The final H1 close is inside while both preceding H1 closes are strictly outside. The original V1.7 12H close already implies the final H1 close is inside; using only an at-least-one threshold would duplicate the whole sample, so this exact last-only state identifies a distinct late reclaim.
price_states.other_observed: Two consecutive inside closes, an interrupted pattern, or a boundary-equality pattern. Retain in feature audit and all-observable control; do not force into either primary cohort.
price_states.missing: Missing/invalid H1 rows or Monday range remain explicit and are excluded only from conditional cohorts; they remain in the no-gate account.

account.capital_allocation: Same actual equal-slot cash allocation and four-child entry/trim path as frozen liquid-queue balanced account.
account.entry_priority: Balanced ordinal rank of previous native H1 minute-average quote turnover and previous ATR, exactly as cloud_close_liquid_queue balanced.
account.entry_cap: 10% of prior completed H1 mean per-minute native quote turnover; missing or zero-volume entries are excluded as in the frozen source.
account.exposure: Frozen source's actual 1x/2x long-short exposure schedule based on prior 30-day ETH/BTC direction.
account.costs: OKX taker 0.0005 per market fill and resting maker 0.0002 per resting limit fill; existing +0.0005 market-fill stress is retained.
account.funding_and_depth: Not modeled; unchanged from the source account.

periods.all: Frozen source account window through 2026-11-08 12:00 UTC.
periods.dev: From frozen account start through 2025-01-01 00:00 UTC.
periods.2026: 2026-01-01 through the frozen source account cutoff.

execution.engine: Native VectorBT shared-cash account called via cloud_close_liquid_queue.main; no custom fill or PnL simulator.
execution.path_source: Frozen 360-name V1.7 actual paths from cloud_close_liquid_queue.repair.pool().
execution.baseline_reuse: Reuse exp-cloud-close-liquid-queue-20261109-v1/balanced outputs only if the reconstructed positive-turnover event IDs equal the frozen 12,284 IDs and frozen baseline metrics reconcile.
